text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.05.01-rc4 complete. Running smoke checks: warmup-heartbeat, prefix-prefill. Initial: 6/120 failing probes (5%). warmup p95 doubled, small 503 tail.

lee: seeing warmup p95 spike on eu-west-1 prefills. queue depth on prefill workers increased.

maya: we enabled the new prefill concurrency flag in this canary. could be oversubscribing local workers.

synth-watchdog: failing hosts: eu-w1-prefill-04..06. Logs show "prefill throttle" and "kv warmup timeout".

oncall-sre: quick check: autoscaler did not scale fast enough; pod cpu at 95% on affected hosts.

lee: mitigation options: A) reduce canary to 1% and route prefills to stable, B) pin affected hosts back to previous runtime, C) full rollback. Recommend A for minimal blast radius.

maya: +1 for A. also increase prefill worker min replicas as follow-up.

deploy-bot: Executing `modify-rollout --model rwd-t5-lite --canary 1 --route-prefill stable --note "temporary fallback due to prefill worker pressure"`

synth-watchdog: scheduled recheck in 90s.

(90s later)
synth-watchdog: recheck: failing probes 0/120, p95 back to baseline.

lee: filing RW-1602 to tune autoscaler and add 10m prefill soak to post-deploy checks. leaving canary at 1% until autoscaler validated.

oncall-sre: monitoring for 60m; pager if prefills_429 > 0.5% for 5m.

maya: updating release notes: "Canary reduced to 1% and prefills routed to stable due to transient prefill worker pressure; autoscaler tuning in progress."
